text:
support_engineer: FYI customer H-983 reporting console graphs blanking out and seeing 500s from analytics API when they run heavy ingest jobs. They say it started after yesterday's large batch ingest.

maria_prod: Any link to the customer ticket or example dashboard?

support_engineer: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/H-983 — attached screenshots show panels stuck with spinner. Customer pasted this curl response from our analytics API:

```
$ curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/analytics/query -d '{"query":"select count(*) from events where timestamp > now() - interval 1 hour"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>'
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"runtime error: kvcache miss and panic at render stage: index out of range"}
```

support_engineer: They also captured a 502 from analytics-proxy earlier: `502 upstream read timeout` around 2026-03-15T18:12Z.

josh_metrics: Do we have any alerts firing? infra-bot: analytics-query-5xx spike alert fired at 2026-03-15T18:11Z, 120s breach, impacted hosts: analytics-03, analytics-04, query-proxy-01.

maria_prod: Repro steps requested — I asked customer to run a small controlled ingest and query, they responded with these steps:
1) POST /ingest/batch with 1.2M events (payload attached)
2) Wait ~30s
3) Open dashboard: panels show spinner, queries return 500/timeout.

support_engineer: I tried to repro on staging with a 200k event batch, couldn't reproduce. When I ramp to 900k in staging, I started seeing increased latencies and occasional 500s from analytics service. Repro script I used: `scripts/load_test.sh --events 900000 --target analytics.internal:8080`

josh_metrics: Logs from analytics-03 show repeated KV cache allocation failures and GC spikes at ~18:10Z:
```
[2026-03-15T18:10:21Z] ERROR runtime: kvcache allocation failed: allocation exceeded pool
[2026-03-15T18:10:24Z] WARN render: query processing timeout after 10s
[2026-03-15T18:11:03Z] ERROR http: write failed: connection reset by peer
```

support_engineer: Customer mentioned their org has a delayed retention job running during ingest window yesterday — maybe hot path + retention compaction causing resource contention.

sre_lead: Assigning to eng-infra and eng-runtime. @josh_metrics can you collect profiles from analytics-03/04 (heap, thread dumps, kernel oops) and attach to ticket? Requesting increased log level on render path for next 30m.

josh_metrics: On it. I'll capture `pmap`/`perf` and thread dumps, plus proxy (nginx) request logs. Adding `--log-level debug` to render service config and will roll to analytics-03 only first.

maria_prod: For short-term mitigation we'd like to:
- gate large customer batch ingests via rate limit
- enable fallback to pre-aggregated tiles for dashboards older than 5m
- temporarily increase request timeout between proxy and analytics to 30s

support_engineer: Customer agreed to throttle their batch and will try queries again in 20m, asked for ETA.

sre_lead: ETA depends on logs/profiles but initial mitigation (proxy timeout bump + throttle) should be doable in 30-45m. I'll open a short maintenance window and coordinate with platform.

josh_metrics: Uploaded tarball with logs/profiles to internal bucket: s3://redwood-debug/1930001111-profiles.tar.gz (private link in ticket). Early look: sustained pause in render loop during KV cache reclaim, correlates exactly with incoming batch write op spikes.

maria_prod: I'll keep the customer updated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

support_engineer: Marking thread in ticket — will post final confirmation after customer verifies dashboard.

(automated): infra-bot: escalation created -> #eng-infra, #eng-runtime; severity P2.
